It is a unique and significant name that represents the triumph of life over death.

The name Marak carries the spiritual significance of having the blessings of the God of Death. It signifies that the bearer of this name has the inner strength to face the challenges of life and the fearlessness to vanquish all adversities, just like Mara, the God of Death, who has the power to overcome the fear of death itself.
